definitions.gloss: rubber boots; rain boots; Wellington boots
definitions.explanation: Waterproof boots, typically made of rubber, worn in rainy weather, when working in muddy or wet conditions, or for outdoor activities. Also refers to tall boots in general.

examples.english: I wear rain boots on rainy days.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧{長靴|ながぐつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{水|みず}たまり→水たまり：19427_mizutamari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: The child is playing in puddles wearing red rain boots.

examples.japanese: {畑仕事|はたけしごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{長靴|ながぐつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{履|は}いている→履く：00700_haku⟧。
examples.english: When doing farm work, I always wear rubber boots.

notes:
USAGE:
In everyday Japanese, {長靴|ながぐつ} most commonly refers to rubber rain boots. Children's rain boots in bright colors are especially associated with this word. For fashionable tall boots, ⟦ブーツ→ブーツ：04529_buutsu⟧ or ⟦ロング→ロング：28289_rongu⟧⟦ブーツ→ブーツ：04529_buutsu⟧ are more commonly used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {長靴|ながぐつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{履|は}く→履く：00700_haku⟧ (put on / wear rain boots)
- ⟦ゴム→ゴム：00073_gomu⟧{長靴|ながぐつ} (rubber boots — emphasizing the material)
- {子|こ}ども⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{長靴|ながぐつ} (children's rain boots)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{長靴|ながぐつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧はいた⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧ (Puss in Boots) is the standard Japanese title for the famous fairy tale.
